triageIndex.label: M-01
triageIndex.title: setRoute validates the last non-zero path entry, but Curve Router NG stops at the first empty pool slot, so a gapped route is accepted and silently strands the intermediate token

triageIndex.label: L-01
triageIndex.title: _sellYield acts on the raw token balance, so 1-wei donations (or a strategy's own sub-dust delivery) brick every harvest

triageIndex.label: L-02
triageIndex.title: Neither the on-chain Unprofitable check nor harvest.sh's minEthOut floor prices the claim NFT burned by SYA; default config sends net-loss harvests

triageIndex.label: L-03
triageIndex.title: Routes and ethPool are validated against sya.rewardToken() only at set time; an SYA setRewardToken bricks harvest and the harvester owner cannot pre-stage the new config

triageIndex.label: L-04
triageIndex.title: harvest.sh cannot decode SYA, strategy, oracle or Router NG reverts, so the operator cannot tell which strategy to exempt (story-005 'readable reason on any simulated revert' unmet)

triageIndex.label: Q-01
triageIndex.title: Borrow/allowance = calculateClaimAmount*1.01 with a false '~10% over-estimate' premise; DOLA runs with only 1% headroom, and over-delivery beyond it reverts the claim

triageIndex.label: Q-02
triageIndex.title: Exact-input V4 swap with sqrtPriceLimitX96 = MAX-1 can partially fill, leaving the unswapped reward token for the next caller

triageIndex.label: Q-03
triageIndex.title: No rescue path: stray non-strategy ERC20s and ERC1155 ids are stuck forever; stray strategy tokens/reward/ETH are swept to the next caller via whole-balance logic

triageIndex.label: Q-04
triageIndex.title: Single aggregate slippage bound: intermediate legs run with minOut 0 / no price limit, harvest() has no deadline and accepts minEthOut=0; MEV exposure if the private relay leaks

triageIndex.label: Q-05
triageIndex.title: Documented 'double fee' mechanism on USDe/crvUSD pool 0xF55B is wrong (opposite-direction trades, not adverse price move); direct USDe/USDC route avoids the round trip

triageIndex.label: Q-06
triageIndex.title: Test-suite fidelity gaps hide DEDUP-001 and DEDUP-005 regressions

triageIndex.label: Q-07
triageIndex.title: Operator script (script/harvest.sh) residuals: no deadline, cast-send timeout re-run, PRIVATE_RPC_URL not verified private
